verdict.rationale: Nix's own docs say it 'Runs on Linux and macOS,' and the same `nix develop`/`nix-shell` workflow and shareable environment definitions work across machines ('if a package works on one machine, it will also work on another'), so two of the three platforms are covered. Windows is never documented as a supported platform; the Docker image is a host-platform workaround, not native support. Missing for 10: native Windows support, documented same-config parity on Windows, and independent hands-on evidence of macOS/Linux config parity.
